status_meaning.EMPTY: No data and no usable source found.
status_meaning.SOURCE_BLOCKED: A legitimate source exists but cannot be reached or accessed from here.
status_meaning.SOURCE_UNVERIFIED: A candidate source exists but its provenance is unclear.
status_meaning.RIGHTS_UNVERIFIED: Data is imported (hidden) or published on declared terms, but publication rights are not established.
status_meaning.IMPORT_READY: Source verified and rights established; importer ready; nothing imported yet.
status_meaning.IMPORTED: Imported and hidden; validation or review incomplete.
status_meaning.VALIDATED: Imported and validated; not yet published.
status_meaning.PUBLISHED: Published with verified rights, but one or more readiness gates are not satisfied (see the gates).
status_meaning.READY: All twelve gates are satisfied for the stated scope.

gates.text: Publication rights are established for the intended use.
The source can be retrieved/imported, or is already legitimately present.
The schema maps the source without inventing missing values.
Duplicates and conflicts are handled deterministically.
Provenance is retained at record level.
The public UI shows verification status accurately.
The assistant can cite the published information.
Tests cover the import and publication lifecycle.
The result has been verified, not assumed.

domains.source: PyPI quran-text (quran.ws, KFGQPC text) 0.1.0; fawazahmed0/quran-api for the two translations; npm @quran.ws/tajwid-* 0.1.0

domains.attribution: CC BY 4.0: quran.ws / KFGQPC, shown with the text
blockers: Rights in the KFGQPC source text are not independently established: the package's CC BY 4.0 declaration is the packager's, the main text package has no recorded source URL, and no KFGQPC grant for the text file (as opposed to the typeface) was found. Written confirmation from KFGQPC, or re-obtaining and comparing the official package, would close this.
Public-domain status of the two translations is term-based reasoning, differs by country, and has had no legal review.
domains.notes: Public-domain status of the two translations can differ by jurisdiction. Verified by scripts/validate_data.py (every ayah's text matches its recorded sha256; source edition approved and ready) and a live assistant query that cites Qur'an passages. Downgraded from READY on 2026-10-03: the rights gate cannot be passed on the packager's declaration alone (see data/rights-ledger.json). The text stays published; every ayah is shown with its licence and source.
